# `state/workflow/Inbox.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/workflow/Inbox.js`

state/workflow/Inbox.js — idempotent inbox / effect receiver (spec §11, rule 42).  The outbox delivers at-least-once, so the receiving side MUST deduplicate by the stable effect id to make the end-to-end behavior effectively-once. The inbox records the first result for each effect id; a redelivery returns the stored result and does NOT re-run the handler (mirrors the transaction IdempotencyRegistry, but for inbound external effects).

| `get` | `get(effectId)` | Stored result for an effect id, or null. |
| `receive` | `async receive(intent, handler)` | Receive an effect exactly once. On first sight, runs `handler(intent)` and stores its result; on redelivery, returns the stored result without re-running the handler. |
